slides.headline: SAM ALTMAN WENT VIRAL AT 1 AM. OVER ROCKS.
slides.kicker: HE CALLED IT THE BEST THING EVER

caption:
Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, ends high-stakes AI calls past midnight and walks home to his kids. 🌙

At 1:09 AM, Sam Altman posted about hanging up a high-stakes phone call and walking sixty seconds to small children who wanted to show him their discoveries. He called it 'the strangest and best thing I have ever experienced in life.' His last call of the day ends past midnight, not after dinner. A million people now picture the CEO most associated with AI changing your job being upstaged nightly by a child who doesn't know what he does.

The most powerful people in AI don't stop being human when they hang up. And sometimes the loudest reminder of that comes from someone who just wants to show you what they found on the floor.

Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we'll show you what AI could do for yours.

Sources: X (sama)
